root_cause.summary: Powerhouse could reclassify an already-created social provider side effect as blocked when later auth, readback or media-proof checks failed.
causes: publication truth and later verification truth were coupled
later policy/media gates were applied retroactively to already-created posts
existing provider IDs were not always treated as terminal anti-duplicate fences

prevention_rules: Provider create success plus durable external ID/URN is terminal publication evidence.
Provider-truth-verified existing Instagram media is terminal publication evidence.
Later OAuth revocation, 401/403 readback, ACL or analytics failure cannot downgrade an already-created post.
Later media-policy drift applies only to future generation and may not retroactively block a live post.
Persist republish_forbidden=true and reconcile exact IDs only.
Daily watchdogs must preserve published state for existing provider side effects.

outcome.intended_state: All daily social provider side effects remain terminally published once created or provider-truth-verified, with no duplicate replacement on later verification drift.
